modules.title: Getting Started
modules.purpose: Fetch public artist metadata using Client Credentials flow
tasks: Obtain client_id and client_secret from Spotify Developer Dashboard
Request access token using POST to /api/token with grant_type=client_credentials
Store access_token and expires_in
Make GET request to https://api.spotify.com/v1/artists/{artist_id} with Authorization header
modules.limitations: Client Credentials flow cannot access user-specific data

modules.title: Authorization Concepts
modules.purpose: Understand supported OAuth flows and their tradeoffs
tasks: Enumerate client-side vs server-side OAuth flows
List required combos of user access, client_secret storage, and refresh token availability

modules.title: Authorization Code + PKCE Flow
modules.purpose: Implement secure OAuth flow in browser or mobile without exposing client_secret
tasks: Generate code_verifier (43–128 char random string)
Compute code_challenge via SHA-256 + base64url
Redirect user to /authorize with client_id, code_challenge, code_challenge_method=S256, scope, redirect_uri, state
On callback, parse ?code and ?state
Exchange code for access_token, refresh_token using code_verifier via POST to /api/token
Store access_token, refresh_token securely client-side

snippets.token_exchange: POST https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token with body { grant_type:'authorization_code', code, redirect_uri, client_id, code_verifier }

modules.title: Access Token
modules.purpose: Explain token format, expiration, and usage in API calls
tasks: Include 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' in all API calls
Track token expiry (3600 seconds)
Implement refresh token exchange when expired

definitions.access_token: Bearer token string valid for 3600 seconds
definitions.refresh_token: token to request new access_token (for auth & PKCE flows)

modules.title: Redirect URIs

Enforce HTTPS except for loopback IPs
Disallow 'localhost', allow IP literals with optional dynamic port for loopback
requirements: HTTPS URI or loopback IP literal (127.0.0.1 or [::1])
Match registrations exactly including slash, case
Dynamic ports permitted only for loopback
